selection: Purposive SCA3/ataxia methods corpus, not a systematic review. Sources selected for natural history, molecular analysis, biomarkers and measurement limitations. No patient-level records are ingested.

sources.boundary: Cohort-average progression is not an individual prognosis or a treatment effect.
Cross-species findings and biomarker associations do not establish a validated clinical surrogate endpoint.

sources.population: Human spinal cord and SCA3 mouse models
sources.boundary: Human donor evidence and mouse experiments are distinct. Differential expression alone does not establish a therapeutic target.
A review synthesizes other studies; it is not an independent participant cohort. Subtype-specific results cannot be transferred automatically.
Consensus recommendations are not prospective validation of this platform or of a specific SCA3 intervention.
Clinic and daily-life measurements differ; observational measurement validity is not evidence of treatment benefit.

not_indexed.reason: Existing snapshot is a medRxiv preprint under CC BY-NC-ND; retained in the original source registry, not repackaged in this new passage corpus.
